summary.root_cause_text: The ops config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration). That provider was unreachable, so the worker marked orders processed without payment.
recommended: Validate that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the provider migration.
Add an alert on provider call failures. They are only logged at DEBUG now.
Make the worker leave orders queued or marked failed when the provider is unreachable, instead of marking them processed.

args.summary: The payment provider URL was switched to payments-v2, which was unreachable. Orders were processed without payment, and /health stayed green. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. check_invariants is now green.
